Read first: .arbos/docs/project-context.md, then .arbos/notes.md
Task: Gather practical trading information: API examples, common strategies, risk management, and code snippets for beginners
Do: as the task says; number your steps in your first reply
Rules: Focus on educational content, include links to docs, avoid financial advice
Output: Deliverables under .arbos/docs/, working notes under .arbos/internal/, captures under .arbos/media/<topic>/. Verify each file exists before you report it.
Report: Summary of trading features, API usage examples, and beginner-friendly strategy concepts
